description.value: The Katsu Japanese Cutlet House is a Japanese restaurant in downtown Langley specializing in panko-breaded katsu made with house-made breadcrumbs and the restaurant's own signature sauces. The menu features chicken, hira pork, kimchi, and cheese katsu variations, all using fresh ingredients. A customer review on the site mentions it as a natural stop before exploring downtown Langley on foot—making it a potential mid-ride meal destination for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thekatsu.ca confirms the OSM address (5576 204 St, Langley, BC V3A 1Z5) and phone (+1-604-539-1121), and the site is active with menu and online ordering features. The website's 'Order Online' link and customer review referencing a full sit-down meal both support takeout availability. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Website page title reads 'The Katsu Cutlet House' while OSM name is 'The Katsu Japanese Cutlet House'; the on-page heading reads 'THE KATSU, JAPANELE CUTTLET HOUSE' (contains typos). Slight name inconsistency across sources.
Website appears to be hosted on a third-party platform (MenuOneCa.com), which may limit the depth of available amenity information.
Website footer contains the phrase 'colsed for today Closed' which may be a dynamic status widget showing a closed state at time of fetch — business does not appear permanently closed.
